scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: Jeremiah overlooking everyday Judean life imaginatively connects the recipient of the word with the people it concerns. The verse gives the two reign dates, not a location, clothing, audience or activity; these visual details are artistic conventions. The named kings and ancestor are absent, and God is not depicted.
